name: Apply Damage
description: Deals a fixed amount of damage to a single target actor and routes it through Unreal's damage pipeline. The damaged actor receives the value through its TakeDamage / OnTakeAnyDamage path.

inputs.name: Damaged Actor
inputs.description: The actor receiving the damage. Must implement or inherit TakeDamage to actually be affected.

inputs.name: Base Damage
inputs.description: The amount of damage to apply. Connect a literal number, a weapon stat variable, or the output of a math node.

inputs.name: Event Instigator
inputs.description: The controller responsible for the damage (used for kill credit, scoring, and friendly-fire checks).

inputs.name: Damage Causer
inputs.description: The actor that physically caused the damage (e.g. a projectile, an explosion source).

inputs.name: Damage Type Class
inputs.description: The damage type class that determines how damage is processed (default UDamageType, or a custom subclass).

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the damage has been dispatched. Continue the graph from here.
